cases.description: A JSON object between the --- delimiters is valid YAML 1.2, so its members are the root's fields.
A # line inside the front matter is a YAML comment, not a level-1 heading, so the heading after the front matter is the record's only level-1 heading and gives the root's $title.
The front matter ends at the next --- line, so --- inside a quoted YAML value neither closes it nor reaches the body.
Without a title heading the root's fields still come from the front matter, and the root's $body is the text between the front matter and the first heading.

A --- line after a blank line is not at the very start of the file, so it is a thematic break, and the next --- line makes 'status: Open' a setext heading (CommonMark 0.31.2, 4.1 and 4.3); the record has no fields.
The front matter's members are the root section's, and $key on a section is a $ member where none is allowed, so the record fails parse.
